title: Art Exhibition & Project Space | Oakland | Dream Farm Commons
meta_description: ​ Dream Farm Commons is a small, artist run exhibition and project space in Downtown Oakland. We are committed to an ongoing engagement with the visual, the poetic, the neighborhood and the future.
plain_text:
Chiapas Support Committee Presents
Dispatches from Resistant Mexico
a series of short documentaries from southern Mexico, each depicting one of the thousands of pockets of resistance throughout Latin America that are in struggle against what the Zapatistas call “the capitalist hydra
December 18, 2021 5-8PM
large format projection at Dream Farm Commons 349 15th Street Oakland Ca​
​
Closing/Film Showing
​
with coffee, tamales and solidarity
​
​
Join us for art, films, solidarity & community!
Dispatches from Resistant Mexico is a series of short documentaries from southern Mexico, each depicting one of the thousands of pockets of resistance throughout Latin America that are in struggle against what the Zapatistas call “the capitalist hydra.”
These individuals and communities affirm a way of life in opposition to capitalist economics and values.
They fight the devastating neoliberal “development” and “mega-projects” that loot resources and land from indigenous communities and threaten forms of life that have survived despite 500 years of colonization.
The resistance shares many of the principles and goals of the Zapatistas:
* Autonomy from the capitalist economy;
* Communalist self-government rooted in indigenous collective traditions;
* An end to the subordination of women; and
* A respectful, life-affirming, non-dominating relation to nature. Indigenous women are at the forefront of many of these ongoing struggles.
Dispatches from Resistant Mexico is part of the Chiapas Support Committee's CompArte Zapatista art show at Dream Farm Commons: "Nuestra lucha es por la vida | Our Struggle is for Life." Check out the Zapatista art show here: https://www.dreamfarmcommons.com/nuestra-lucha-es-por-la-vida
Please wear a face mask & practice social distancing.
FILMS & DISCUSSION
The film screening will be followed by discussion with the filmmakers and other CSC members, including an update on the current situation in Chiapas and an invitation to take action with the CSC on December 22nd in San Francisco.
The screening is outdoors and we recommend coming ready for chilly weather. We will have some seating available and, if you can, bring a chair and a blanket.
We will have coffee, refreshments and tamales; requesting a donation and no one turned away for lack of funds. C/S
WHEN: Saturday, December 18, 2021, 5:00-8:00pm
WHERE: Dream Farm Commons, 349 15th Street Oakland CA 94612 (Close to the 14th Street BART Station.)
For more info: www.chiapas-support.org
​
